themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retailer Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints spiked to 4 this week versus a 0.9 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 357% spike (z-score: 4.0)—suggesting rapid expansion or enforcement issues in Greenwich Village/SoHo's newly legal retail market.
evidence: 4 cannabis retailer complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (357% increase)
Z-score of 4.0 indicates statistically significant spike
Timing aligns with post-legalization retail expansion in NYC
reporting_angles: Which cannabis retailers are opening in the district and how many are licensed vs. unlicensed?
What specific complaints are residents filing (odor, loitering, noise, operational violations)?

themes_detail.label: Elevator Maintenance Crisis Emerging
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints jumped to 9 last week versus a 2.0 weekly average—a 350% spike (z-score: 5.72)—suggesting a sudden wave of building maintenance failures or elevator breakdowns affecting residents.
evidence: 9 elevator complaints LAST WEEK vs. 2.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (350% increase)
Z-score of 5.72 indicates high statistical significance
Aligns with CB budget request for 'Maintenance or Facility' upgrades (36 complaints last week, 227% above baseline)
reporting_angles: Are specific buildings experiencing repeated elevator failures, or is this district-wide?
How long are residents typically waiting for DOB elevator inspections and repairs?

themes_detail.label: Outdoor Dining Regulation Friction
themes_detail.summary: Outdoor dining complaints surged to 25 last week versus an 8.9 weekly average—a 182% spike (z-score: 3.19)—indicating mounting resident frustration with outdoor seating programs or enforcement.
evidence: 25 outdoor dining complaints LAST WEEK vs. 8.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (182% increase)
SoHo and Greenwich Village have high concentration of restaurants with outdoor seating; newly elected CB representative (Carl Wilson, elected 2026-04-29) may address in new term
reporting_angles: Which specific blocks or restaurants are generating the most complaints (noise, obstruction, sanitation)?
Is the city's outdoor dining program enforcement matching resident expectations?

themes_detail.label: Tree Health Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Dead/dying tree complaints exploded to 4 last week from a 0.4 weekly baseline—a 967% spike (z-score: 7.49)—the highest z-score in the dataset, signaling rapid urban forestry decline or pest/disease outbreak.
evidence: 4 dead/dying tree complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (967% spike—highest z-score: 7.49)
CB has made 'Forestry services, including street tree maintenance' a recurring budget request, indicating chronic underinvestment
May signal emerging pest (spotted lanternfly, Asian longhorned beetle) or disease outbreak affecting street canopy
reporting_angles: Are these isolated incidents or signs of a district-wide pest or disease spreading through the urban forest?
How is Parks Department responding to the uptick, and what is the tree removal/replacement timeline?

themes_detail.label: Water Quality Complaints Double
themes_detail.summary: Water quality complaints spiked to 4 two weeks ago versus a 0.4 weekly baseline—a 967% spike (z-score: 5.21)—raising questions about tap water safety or plumbing failures across the district.
evidence: 4 water quality complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (967% increase)
Coincides with CB budget request for 'Clean catch basins' and ongoing Housing Preservation & Development inspection requests, suggesting aging infrastructure
reporting_angles: Are residents reporting discoloration, odor, or taste issues, or are these related to lead/PFOA concerns?
Which blocks or buildings are affected, and has DEP issued a boil water advisory?
